necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness, raising clinical concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias (I49.9). To accurately capture the frequency and duration of these symptomatic events for appropriate management, a mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) was medically necessary. This diagnostic procedure is essential to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances and guide subsequent therapeutic interventions.
